questions.question: Who is known as the Father of the Indian Constitution?
questions.questionHtml: Who is known as the Father of the Indian Constitution?
questions.solution: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar is known as the Father of the Indian Constitution as he was the Chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Constituent Assembly.
questions.subject: general-awareness

questions.question: How many fundamental rights are guaranteed by the Indian Constitution?
questions.questionHtml: How many fundamental rights are guaranteed by the Indian Constitution?
questions.solution: There are 6 fundamental rights guaranteed by the Indian Constitution: Right to Equality, Right to Freedom, Right against Exploitation, Right to Freedom of Religion, Cultural and Educational Rights, and Right to Constitutional Remedies.
questions.subject: general-awareness

questions.question: What is the minimum age for becoming the Prime Minister of India?
questions.questionHtml: What is the minimum age for becoming the Prime Minister of India?
questions.solution: There is no minimum age requirement for becoming the Prime Minister of India according to the Constitution. However, the person must be a member of the Lok Sabha, which requires a minimum age of 25 years.
questions.subject: general-awareness

questions.question: The Preamble of the Indian Constitution was amended in which year?
questions.questionHtml: The Preamble of the Indian Constitution was amended in which year?
questions.solution: The Preamble was amended in 1976 by the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act, which added the words 'Socialist', 'Secular', and 'Integrity' to the Preamble.
questions.subject: general-awareness

questions.question: Which article of the Indian Constitution deals with the Right to Constitutional Remedies?
questions.questionHtml: Which article of the Indian Constitution deals with the Right to Constitutional Remedies?
questions.solution: Article 32 of the Indian Constitution deals with the Right to Constitutional Remedies. It allows citizens to move to the Supreme Court for the enforcement of fundamental rights.
